name: Kawai Yukihiro
source:
Birthplace: Tokyo
Lives with his parents and younger sister.
A high school student who loves his parents. He's putting his all into his part time job in order to help with the finances.
A helpful and nice person who is popular with the girls at his fast food job.
But he can be a bit of a worrywart and act like an old man at times.
